phrases.latin: Mendum est sīcut lapillus quī in calceō tuō latet: nōn bene ambulās, dōnec lapillum invēneris et ējēceris. Jam tenēs?
phrases.english: A bug is like a pebble hiding in your shoe: you can’t walk properly until you find the pebble and throw it out. Do you get it now?
